items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: David has an impeccable beat and it fits perfectly with Mr. Jones on drums. ... I was lucky enough to uh have received all of those from Mr. Jones, Sam Jones in this case.

ctx.x: Sissle, yeah. Unusual name, I think. He might have been from Trinidad too. But uh, anyway, it's one of the names I heard from my father. But anyway, David has an impeccable beat and it fits perfectly with Mr. Jones on drums. Uh, I'm in Heaven, uh, you know, don’t have to die, I'm already there. [chuckles] Because if I do pass away, I might go in the other direction, of course. I'm uh, I'm joshing now. I don't know. Heaven is probably right here on earth. Brower:They do’t have enough asbestos for you.
